summary: Shows to_uuid for namespaced UUIDv5 values (custom or default Ansible namespace) and using map(attribute=...) with join to list mount points.
questions: How do I generate a deterministic UUID from a string in Ansible?
How do I get a comma-separated list of mount points?

answer_card.title: UUIDs and mapping attributes
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ string | to_uuid(namespace='11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555') }}
{{ string | to_uuid }}   # default Ansible namespace
```

```jinja
{{ ansible_mounts | map(attribute='mount') | join(',') }}
```
